title: OrgGraph harvest specification
description: Normative gate artifact per provider (PRD FR-6.1c, E28, E31): source access, source-field-to-registry mapping, and crawl strategy, finalized from the source contract's harvestSpecDraft. phase-b-harvest.js is derived from this spec and references specVersion; phase B refuses to run if the referenced spec is missing, invalid, or version-mismatched.

specVersion.description: Version stamp referenced by phase-b-harvest.js (PRD E31).

registryVersion.description: Registry version the gate decisions were made against (PRD FR-6.1b).

basedOnAnalysis.description: runId of the source contract this spec was finalized from.

access.description: Source access: endpoints/selectors, navigation, and stable-id derivation (PRD FR-6.1c, FR-6.2).

mapping.description: Gate-confirmed mapping source field -> registry type/edge/property; nothing outside this mapping is exported (PRD FR-6.1 phase B).

scope.description: Scope the crawl declares (PRD FR-5.5, FR-6.6); edgeSources is filled at run time with the actually visited source ids.

traversal.description: Traversal order, e.g. "bfs from roots via children".

source.description: Source field: selector, JSON path, or field name as identified in the source contract.

type.description: Registry node/edge type (required for kind node/edge; prop owner type for kind prop).
